title: Define the YAML record shapes and build the docs query tool
brief: End state: references/product-template.md defines the YAML shape for each product-memory surface (product, roadmap, architecture, lessons, claims, examples, trail), and skills/outputty/docs.js answers a query against any of them without reading the file whole. Runs on bun for Bun.YAML.parse. Read-only: it never writes a doc. Include a Mermaid diagram of the record sets and the one query path. Verified constraint to carry into the template: Bun.YAML.stringify escapes a multi-line string into one quoted line instead of emitting a | block, so docs are authored as YAML text and stringify is never used on prose. Tests in skills/outputty/docs.test.js, wired into package.json's test script beside tasks.test.js. Do NOT touch tasks.js (t-graph owns it).
contract: In: docs.js <set> [--<field> <value>] [--json]. Out: the matching records, JSON with --json, else one line per record. Worked example is .claude/examples.md 'A product-doc query': docs.js lessons --files hooks/protocol.md --json over a two-record set returns only the record whose files contain that path.

title: Move the task graph from JSONL to YAML
brief: End state: the task graph is .claude/trails/<branch>.tasks.yaml, a YAML list of the existing task record. Only loadTasks and saveTasks change; ready and schedule are untouched (verified: schedule ran unmodified against a parsed YAML record). require-grill.js matches the new extension and derives the trail path from it. Its 'has this branch settled a decision' check stays a text-shape regex over the trail, so the hook keeps running on node. Also fix a live bug found while planning this branch: taskFile() builds `.claude/trails/${branch}.tasks.yaml`, so a branch named `feature/x` derives a nested path that never exists, and loadTasks returns [] for a missing file, so `schedule` prints '(no open tasks)' instead of failing. That is a silent wrong answer on the flow's own gate preview. Slugify the branch separator and make a missing file for an explicitly-named graph fail loud. Convert this branch's own graph as the migration's first test. tasks.test.js updated, including a case for a slashed branch name. Do NOT touch the other nine hooks: none of them parse the graph, and moving them off node reproduces the 0.44.1 silent-guard failure recorded in .claude/lessons.md.
contract: In: .claude/trails/<branch>.tasks.yaml. Out: schedule --json layers identical to today's JSONL output for the same tasks. Worked example is .claude/examples.md 'A task line (the graph's unit)': the t-1 record in, [[{id: t-1, ...}]] out.

title: Convert the docs that are already records
brief: End state: roadmap.yaml, examples.yaml, product.yaml and claims/*.yaml replace their markdown, each matching the shape t-query defined. claims/ stays one file per claim: targeted loading already works, so collapsing it wins nothing. product.yaml keeps the North Star as a | block and the Language glossary as records. docs.js queries all four. Delete the markdown originals rather than leaving them beside the YAML: two copies of one decision drift in two directions.
contract: In: docs.js roadmap --status shipped --json. Out: the shipped rows as records, each with feature, status, depends_on, notes.

title: Convert architecture and move its diagrams to their own folder
brief: End state: architecture.yaml holds the prose sections as | blocks and the two genuine record sets as records: protocols (7 seams, each from/to/in/out) and memory_surfaces (5, each path/holds/lifecycle). .claude/architecture/ holds the graphs and the YAML references them by path. One Mermaid block exists in .claude/ today, the flow-at-a-glance, which becomes architecture/flow.mmd. This task establishes the prose-in-YAML convention that t-lessons and t-trails reuse, so state it in the template. Delete the markdown original.
contract: In: docs.js architecture --protocol 'PLAN -> tasks.js' --json. Out: that seam's record, with from, to, in and out as separate fields rather than one prose line.

title: Convert the 1494-line lessons chronology
brief: End state: lessons.yaml replaces lessons.md. Every chronology entry becomes a record: version, title, kind, files, body as a | block using t-architecture's convention. No entry is dropped, and the done-condition is that the entry count out equals the entry count in. Append-only semantics preserved. This is the file the whole feature exists for: 1494 lines under two headings today. Delete the markdown original. STOP and report the entry if any of them resists the record shape, rather than forcing it.
contract: In: docs.js lessons --files hooks/protocol.md --json. Out: only records whose files list contains that path. Worked example is .claude/examples.md 'A product-doc query'.

title: Convert the branch trails
brief: End state: all 17 trails are YAML matching references/trail.md's four sections: core_objective as a | block, then decisions, not_yet_specified and out_of_scope as record lists. references/trail.md documents the YAML format instead of the markdown one. Verify require-grill.js's decision check still passes against a real converted trail: t-graph made it extension-aware, and this is where that is proven. Delete the markdown originals.
contract: In: docs.js trail feature-yaml-product-memory --decisions --json. Out: the decision records, each with question, answer and link as separate fields.

title: Point every reader at the query instead of the file
brief: End state: every instruction that told an agent to read a product doc tells it to query one. This is the half that makes the format pay: a YAML file nobody queries costs the same read the markdown did. 24 files name the docs; the dense ones are grill/SKILL.md (13 refs), spec.md (12), protocol.md (11), README.md (11), plan.md (9), audit/SKILL.md (7), agents/outputty-docs.md (7), master-qa (6). bootstrap writes YAML. The README goes through the documentation skill, never hand-edited. docs/flow.svg and skills/diagram/examples/flowchart.svg render the doc filenames as text, so redraw them via the diagram skill. Do NOT touch marketplace.json, hooks.json, settings.json, package.json or .oxlintrc.json: their formats are fixed by Claude Code, pnpm and oxlint. STOP and report if a reference cannot become a query because the reader genuinely needs the whole file.
contract: Mechanical sweep, checked by grep: rg -c 'product\.md|roadmap\.md|architecture\.md|lessons\.md|examples\.md' skills agents hooks README.md returns no hits except a deliberate historical mention inside lessons.yaml.
